name: wabi
description: The operating platform for WhatsApp Business, by Meter: connect your own WhatsApp Business Account (or start on a simulated sandbox number), send and receive messages, manage templates, contacts and AI support agents, and read usage and costs, from the conversation, the CLI or CI.

api_key.title: Wabi API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your browser (/mcp). Or paste a wabi_… key from https://getwabi.dev/dashboard/settings?ref=plugin for a machine without a browser: Claude Code keeps it in your system's secure credential store and sends it only to the Wabi MCP server, in the X-Api-Key header.
